name: @mesh/weather-interface
description: Standard current-conditions and short forecast contract, independent of its providers.

available.description: Whether current conditions have been fetched

location.description: Display name of the forecast location

temperature.description: Current temperature in the provider's unit

feels_like.description: Apparent temperature in the provider's unit

condition.description: Semantic condition: clear, partly-cloudy, cloudy, fog, drizzle, rain, snow or storm

is_day.description: Whether the location is in daylight

updated_at.description: Unix time in seconds of the last successful fetch
